50/S0.subgoal: Describe the four stages of model development for realistic walking behavior.

50/S1.subgoal: Describe the empirical research and data collection process for building the walking behavior model.

50/S2.subgoal: Explain the data analysis results and observations made during the empirical study.

50/S3.subgoal: Explain the model proposal based on the CISO pattern and Fourier series.

50/S4.subgoal: Explain how visual gain is used to reconcile actual and perceived walking speeds.

50/S5.subgoal: Describe the empirical study used to evaluate the realism and user preference of the walking speed model.

50/S6.subgoal: Summarize the development and evaluation of the walking speed model and its implications for future research.
